description: This source file defines the 'Event' model class for managing event records within the OpenCart administration setting module. It provides CRUD operations such as adding, deleting, updating, and fetching event data from the database.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A class for managing event records in the OpenCart admin setting module, including creating, deleting, updating, and retrieving events.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event record in the database and returns its primary key.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event record from the database using the event ID.

methods.name: deleteEventByCode
methods.description: Deletes an event record using its unique code.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an event by its ID.

methods.name: editStatusByCode
methods.description: Updates the status of an event by its code.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event record by its ID.

methods.name: getEventByCode
methods.description: Fetches an event by its code.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of events based on optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalEvents
methods.description: Returns the total number of event records in the database, optionally filtered.
